_about: How each brand's phones enter a test and come back. General knowledge as of 2026, NOT verified per model by this project: check your exact model (unlockability differs by region/carrier and changes with firmware). Used by tools/assess_device.py and BRANDS.md. Unlocking a bootloader wipes the phone's data on nearly every brand: that is the owner's step and decision (SAFETY.md R7).

samsung.unlock: OEM unlocking in Developer options, then the Download Mode unlock prompt (international/Exynos and most non-US Snapdragon models). US/Canada carrier Snapdragon models are generally not unlockable.
samsung.restore: Download Mode (Odin protocol: samloader/Odin/Heimdall). This toolkit flashes ONLY the original recovery there.
samsung.caveats: Knox warranty bit is set permanently by a custom boot; Samsung Pay/Secure Folder stop working. Images need the AVB footer + SEANDROIDENFORCE trailer. Proven here: S10 Lite (r5q).

xiaomi.unlock: Mi Unlock tool with a Xiaomi account and a waiting period (newer HyperOS devices may require community approval).
xiaomi.restore: fastboot ROM with MiFlash (never with the lock option); EDL needs an authorized account.
xiaomi.caveats: Anti-rollback: never flash an older ROM. POCO and Redmi are Xiaomi. Proven by the donor: POCO X5 Pro (redwood).

google.unlock: OEM unlocking in Developer options, then fastboot flashing unlock (carrier models may block it).
google.caveats: Pixel 6 and later use Google Tensor (Exynos-derived, not Qualcomm): no Mu-Silicium UEFI for it, so the boot chain needs a UEFI port first. Pixel 3-5 are Qualcomm (SDM845/SM7150/SM7250).

oneplus.unlock: fastboot oem unlock (older) / fastboot flashing unlock.
oneplus.restore: MSM Download Tool (EDL) for most models; fastboot ROMs for many.
oneplus.caveats: Many OnePlus SoCs have Mu-Silicium ports (sm8250 kebab, sm8350 lemonade, sm8550 aston/salami, ...).

motorola.unlock: unlock code from Motorola's site (not for carrier-locked models).
motorola.restore: stock firmware with fastboot (Rescue and Smart Assistant).

nothing.restore: fastboot images; EDL for a hard brick.
nothing.caveats: Phone (1) spacewar is SM7325 like redwood; Phone (2) pong is SM8475: both have Mu-Silicium ports.

sony.unlock: unlock code from Sony's developer site.
sony.caveats: Unlocking erases the DRM (TA) keys permanently: camera quality and some features are lost for good.

oppo.unlock: deep-testing app on some models only; many cannot be unlocked.
oppo.restore: MSM Download Tool (EDL, often needs an authorized account)
oppo.caveats: realme and OnePlus share much of this; check the exact model.

realme.unlock: deep-testing app on some models only.
realme.caveats: bitra (sm8250), senna (sm8475), bale (sm8635) have Mu-Silicium ports.

asus.unlock: the official unlock app, on models where Asus provides it.
asus.caveats: ROG Phone 5 (i005d, sm8350) has a Mu-Silicium port.

lg.unlock: LG's unlock program ended with its phone business; few models unlockable.
lg.caveats: G8x (mh2, sm8150) and V35 (caymanslm, sdm845) have Mu-Silicium ports.

huawei.caveats: Kirin SoCs; treat as not portable.
